title: Pixar Characters
description: Names, sidekicks, families — who's who across Pixar.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the cowgirl doll introduced in Toy Story 2?
questions.explanation: Jessie is voiced by Joan Cusack; her backstory song 'When She Loved Me' performed by Sarah McLachlan is one of Pixar's most heartbreaking moments.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Jessie's horse in the Toy Story films?
questions.explanation: Bullseye never speaks but communicates with expressive whinnies and movement; he's animated like a loyal dog more than a horse.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the pink strawberry-scented bear villain in Toy Story 3?
questions.explanation: Lotso is voiced by Ned Beatty; the character was originally conceived for the first Toy Story but cut due to fur-rendering limitations at the time.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the spork toy Bonnie creates in Toy Story 4?
questions.explanation: Forky is voiced by Tony Hale; his existential crisis about being trash inspired the spinoff series 'Forky Asks a Question' on Disney+.

questions.prompt: Who is the toy-torturing neighbor kid in the original Toy Story?
questions.explanation: Sid Phillips makes a brief cameo in Toy Story 3 as the garbage collector; the same actor, Erik von Detten, voiced him in both films.

questions.prompt: Who is Mr. Incredible's wife in The Incredibles?
questions.explanation: Helen Parr is voiced by Holly Hunter; Elastigirl was originally going to be Mr. Incredible's mother in an earlier script before Brad Bird reworked it.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the Parr family's invisible teenage daughter?
questions.explanation: Violet is voiced by Sarah Vowell, a writer and radio personality who had never acted before; her power is invisibility and force fields.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the Parr family baby with emerging powers?
questions.explanation: Jack-Jack displays at least 17 different powers in Incredibles 2 (2018), making him the most powerful member of the family.

questions.prompt: Who is the diminutive superhero costume designer in The Incredibles?
questions.explanation: Edna Mode is voiced by director Brad Bird himself; her design blends Edith Head, Linda Hunt, and Anna Wintour into one fashion icon.

questions.prompt: Who is the ice-powered superhero best friend of Mr. Incredible?
questions.explanation: Frozone is voiced by Samuel L. Jackson; his exasperated 'Where is my super suit?!' scene is one of the most quoted lines in Pixar history.

questions.prompt: Who is the main villain in The Incredibles?
questions.explanation: Syndrome (real name Buddy Pine) is voiced by Jason Lee; his obsession-with-his-idol arc echoes the Joker's relationship with Batman.

questions.prompt: Who is Nemo's overprotective clownfish father in Finding Nemo?
questions.explanation: Marlin's overprotectiveness stems from losing his wife Coral and all but one egg to a barracuda in the film's opening minutes.

questions.prompt: Who is the leader of the fish tank gang in Finding Nemo?
questions.explanation: Gill is a Moorish idol voiced by Willem Dafoe; he serves as Nemo's mentor figure during his time in the dentist's tank.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the laid-back sea turtle in Finding Nemo?
questions.explanation: Crush is voiced by director Andrew Stanton himself; the surfer-dude dialogue was largely improvised during recording sessions.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the chameleon villain in Monsters, Inc.?
questions.explanation: Randall Boggs is voiced by Steve Buscemi; his ability to camouflage was inspired by chameleons and cephalopods like cuttlefish.

questions.prompt: Who is the rusty tow truck and best friend of Lightning McQueen?
questions.explanation: Mater is based on a real 1956-ish International Harvester tow truck spotted by the Cars team in Galena, Kansas during Route 66 research.

questions.prompt: Who is the blue Porsche and love interest in Cars?
questions.explanation: Sally Carrera is voiced by Bonnie Hunt; she's modeled after a 2002 Porsche 911 Carrera, and her name doubles as the car model name.

questions.prompt: Who is the wilderness explorer scout who stows away on Carl's house in Up?
questions.explanation: Russell's design was based on Pixar story artist Peter Sohn, who later directed The Good Dinosaur and Elemental.

questions.prompt: Who is the villainous explorer Carl idolized as a boy in Up?
questions.explanation: Charles Muntz is voiced by Christopher Plummer; his name is a nod to Charles Mintz, the producer who took Oswald the Lucky Rabbit from Walt Disney.

questions.prompt: Who is the human chef and garbage boy taught to cook by Remy in Ratatouille?
questions.explanation: Alfredo Linguini is revealed to be the late chef Gusteau's biological son, which is why he inherited the restaurant.

questions.prompt: Who is the only female chef in Gusteau's kitchen and Linguini's love interest?
questions.explanation: Colette is voiced by Janeane Garofalo; her speech about the sexism of professional kitchens was praised for its real-world accuracy.

questions.prompt: What is the name of EVE's love interest in WALL-E?
questions.explanation: WALL-E and EVE's romance unfolds with almost no spoken dialogue; their robotic 'voices' were designed by Star Wars sound legend Ben Burtt.

questions.prompt: Who is the musician grandfather Miguel meets in the Land of the Dead in Coco?
questions.explanation: Hector is voiced by Gael García Bernal; he turns out to be Miguel's great-great-grandfather, the actual composer of 'Remember Me'.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Merida's mother in Brave?
questions.explanation: Queen Elinor is voiced by Emma Thompson; she spends most of Brave (2012) transformed into a bear, mirroring her conflict with Merida.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Mei's mother in Turning Red?
questions.explanation: Ming Lee is voiced by Sandra Oh; her own giant red panda form in the climax dwarfs Mei's, symbolizing generations of suppressed emotion.
